info.title: Xevrion Autopilot API
info.description: Back-office automation for UK sole traders. VAT/SA outputs are DRAFTS on unverified rules; not tax advice.

project_id.description: Agent review project the key is bound to (null = whole tenant)

allowed_cidrs.description: Client networks the key may be used from (null = anywhere)

payload.description: Current payload (after any edits): what runs if approved

post.summary: Create a tenant (caller becomes owner) with default chart of accounts
Create an accountancy practice (caller becomes partner); seeds default close templates

get.summary: The signed-in staff member's practice, role and plan quota

post.summary: Add or change a staff member (partner only)

delete.summary: Remove a staff member and their assignments (partner only; the last partner cannot be removed)

get.summary: Clients visible to me with health, review backlog, queries and next deadline (worst health first)

post.summary: Add a client business (creates its books with the default chart of accounts); partner/manager

get.summary: Client detail: settings, health, deadlines and assignments

patch.summary: Change client settings: deadlines config, fees, auto-approve policy, QA sampling, SLA, status (partner/manager)

get.summary: Deadlines across all my clients (VAT, Self Assessment, MTD ITSA), overdue first. UNVERIFIED dates.
Practice dashboard: client health, workload, review backlog by age, deadlines, risk flags, WIP and billing-ready

post.summary: Cross-client bulk action. Without confirmToken: dry-run preview + token. With the matching token: executes. Max 50 clients.

get.summary: Items awaiting first-pass review across my clients, oldest first, with SLA state and auto-approve eligibility

post.summary: Approve review items (optionally correcting the category first). Corrections feed learning and the eval harness.
Bulk-approve high-confidence items (confidence floor 0.9) across clients. Preview first; execute with confirmToken. Max 1000.
Claim review items for yourself or assign them to a colleague (managers may assign to others)
Apply the client's auto-approve policy (allowlisted categories at >= threshold, floor 0.9) and QA-sample the result

get.summary: Auto-approved items sampled for QA and not yet checked, plus the QA pass rate so far

post.summary: Record a QA check of an auto-approved item; a fail must give the correct category (recategorises + logs)
Create a close checklist template (partner/manager)
Start a close checklist for a client and period from a template

get.summary: Checklist with items and live evidence (review backlog, open queries, exceptions up to the period end)

post.summary: Tick or untick a checklist item (not on a completed checklist)
Complete and lock a checklist (reviewer/manager/partner; all required items done; no items awaiting review in the period)
Ask the client a question, optionally about a transaction (shows in their portal; emits query.raised; no email)
Close a query (after the client answered, or to withdraw it)
Create a recurring work template (partner/manager)
Generate this month's recurring tasks for all active clients (idempotent per template, client and due date)

patch.summary: Update a task's status or assignee (assigning others needs partner/manager)

post.summary: Record time against a client (internal)

get.summary: Time entries (mine, or everyone's for partners/managers)
Work in progress and billing-ready clients (internal valuation; nothing is invoiced or charged)

post.summary: Turn a client's WIP into an internal billing record (marks the time as billed). Not an invoice; nothing is sent.
Import a client's bank statement CSV (text/csv body); de-duplicated, then the AI first pass runs
Draft an engagement letter (managers). The letter text is hashed; the hash is frozen once sent.
Mark a draft as sent: it appears in the client portal for acceptance. Nothing is emailed.
Withdraw a draft or sent letter
Record an agent authorisation (64-8 style). DATA ONLY: no HMRC request is made. References are masked on write.
Confirm or revoke an authorisation record
Request documents from a client (explicit titles and/or a template). Shown in the portal; nothing is emailed.

get.summary: Document requests across my clients (the upload checklist)

post.summary: Waive an open document request
Invite a client contact to the portal. MOCK delivery: the single-use magic token (15 min) is returned here for staff to hand over; Autopilot never emails it.
Revoke a portal user and every token they hold

get.summary: Per-client audit trail (practice chain entries + the client's own audit log) with whole-chain verification

post.summary: Prepare a working paper: an immutable, hashed snapshot of the client ledger at a period end

get.summary: One working paper with integrity check

post.summary: Four-eyes sign-off (reviewer/manager/partner, never the preparer). Refused if the ledger changed since the snapshot. Immutable after.
Re-derive learned rules from reviewer corrections. Firm-wide rules need 2+ clients to agree. Disabled rules stay disabled.

get.summary: Learned rules visible to me (firm-wide rules + rules of clients I can see), with provenance

post.summary: Disable or re-enable a learned rule (managers)

get.summary: Explain unreviewed items: current AI category vs learned-rule suggestion, with reason codes and evidence
Explainable anomalies for a client (duplicates, missing receipts, unusual VAT, round sums, weekend postings)

post.summary: Dismiss one anomaly with a note (audited)

get.summary: Anomaly counts by client and severity across my clients (last 12 months)
Accuracy harness: how often AI categories survive accountant review, by month, client and confidence band
Drift alerts: accuracy drop vs baseline, overconfidence, QA failure rate

post.summary: Ask about your clients. Rules-based intent routing first, then a MOCK LLM router that may only pick an intent. Answers are computed from ledger data you can see, with citations.

get.summary: What integrations exist and how real each one is (real / mock / interface)

post.summary: Pull transactions from a client's ledger (MOCK adapter) into Autopilot via the normal dedupe + categorisation pipeline

get.summary: This month's metered usage vs plan caps (plans are placeholders; nothing is billed)

post.summary: Exchange a single-use magic token for an 8-hour portal session (mock magic-link flow; no email)
End this portal session

get.summary: Who I am, my business and my practice, with counts of things waiting for me

post.summary: Answer an open query (emits query.answered; the practice sees it in its queue)

get.summary: Documents my accountant needs from me

post.summary: Upload the requested document (raw body; PDF/image/CSV/XLSX up to 10 MB; scanned; stored privately)
Accept a letter. The client echoes the sha256 of the text they read, which must match the frozen hash.
Add a user
Upload a bank statement CSV (creates a job and queues the pipeline)
Upload a receipt (PDF/image). Optional x-receipt-* headers carry known totals until OCR lands.
Add a category
Add a rule
Create a draft invoice (sequential numbering)
Change status (draft→sent→paid, or void). Does not email anyone.

get.summary: Render the invoice as PDF (A4, pdf-lib)

post.summary: Compute and store a DRAFT VAT return (unverified rates, never submitted)
Approve, override (re-categorise) or dismiss an exception
Re-queue a job (idempotent stages)

get.summary: Event log (newest first); filter by type or entity.*
Audit timeline (who did what, newest first)

post.summary: Create endpoint (secret returned once)
Rotate signing secret (old one valid for 24h)
Replay a delivery now
Send a signed test ping to this endpoint
Create automation (JSON definition)
Create from a template
Restore a soft-deleted automation
Test an automation against a stored event or a sample payload (no side effects)
Create a scoped API key (shown once)
Rotate: new key now, old key valid 24h

put.summary: Set the API key policy (applies to keys created or rotated from now on)

post.summary: Create an inbound webhook trigger (secret shown once)

get.summary: Full-text search over transactions and invoices

post.summary: Categorise up to 200 transactions; partial success, per-item results

patch.summary: Edit a draft invoice (If-Match or version required)

delete.summary: Soft-delete a draft or void invoice

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted invoice

get.summary: This month's metered usage vs plan quota
Feature flags effective for this tenant
Live event stream (SSE, or WebSocket with Upgrade); ?types=transaction.*

post.summary: Import a bank statement (OFX/QIF/MT940/CSV) or a Xero/QuickBooks/FreshBooks export; exact duplicates skipped, probable ones reported

get.summary: Rules learned from your corrections (not yet applied)

post.summary: Apply learned rules (owner); returns the rules created

get.summary: Recurring payments and income (subscriptions, rent, DDs)
Cash forecast and runway from recurring flows and recent history
Categories whose spend jumped vs the trailing 3-month median
Profit and loss for a period
Cash flow (direct method) for a period

post.summary: Mileage allowance estimate (from body, or this tax year's mileage log)
Home office: flat rate vs actual proportion
Annual Investment Allowance estimate

get.summary: Tax pot estimate for a tax year from the ledger (UNVERIFIED rates; not advice)
Upcoming SA, VAT and MTD deadlines (UNVERIFIED dates; reminders are events only)

post.summary: Log a business trip

get.summary: Balance with payments and credit notes

post.summary: Record a full or partial payment (overpayment rejected)
Issue a credit note (≤ outstanding; VAT reversed proportionally)
Create a payment link via the configured provider (MOCK only; nothing is charged or sent)
Set a draft invoice's currency; stores the FX rate to GBP from the provider (MOCK rates)
Emit invoice.reminder_due events for unpaid invoices (no emails are sent)
Create a recurring invoice schedule (issues drafts; never sends)
Issue any due drafts (idempotent per date; catch-up capped at 12)
Extract receipt/invoice fields from text (OCR/PDF text). Low confidence → needsReview
OCR a stored receipt (MOCK OCR engine) and extract fields; stores the result on the document for review

get.summary: Quarterly obligations for a tax year (MOCK gateway)

post.summary: Build the quarterly update from the ledger without submitting
Submit a quarterly update to the MOCK gateway (owner; confirm required). Never reaches HMRC
Comment on any record; @email mentions notify tenant members
Resolve a comment thread item
Request sign-off to close a period (notifies accountants and owners)
Approve or reject a close (accountant or owner; never the requester)
Mark one read
Mark all read

get.summary: Businesses I belong to (switch with the x-tenant-id header)

post.summary: Subject access request: everything held about an email in this tenant
Erase or pseudonymise a person's data; accounting records are retained (legal obligation) and reported
Record a consent grant or withdrawal (append-only log)

get.summary: Current consent state per subject and purpose (latest record wins) plus history
Full tenant data export (portability), JSON; document files are referenced by key

post.summary: Ask a question about your books; grounded answer with citations

get.summary: Setup checklist computed from your data

post.summary: Load clearly-labelled synthetic sample transactions (only into an empty account)

delete.summary: Remove sample transactions (and anything linked to them)

get.summary: Accounts available from the bank-feed provider (MOCK provider, synthetic)

post.summary: Connect a provider account (mock)
Pull new transactions since the last sync (de-duplicated; first sync covers 90 days)

get.summary: Operator-only cross-tenant aggregates (no PII); requires ADMIN_EMAILS

post.summary: Create a review project in one environment (owner only; API keys cannot create projects)

callbackSecret.description: Signs per-request callbacks. Shown once; rotate to replace.

post.summary: Replace the project's callback signing secret (owner only; shown once). Callbacks sent after this use the new secret.
Save a new immutable policy version (draft). Unsafe rules (auto-approve without confidence, critical auto-approve) are refused.
Time-travel replay: re-run past requests against a candidate policy (a document or a saved version) and diff the outcomes

Activate a version for all traffic, or as a canary for canaryPercent of new requests. Refused (409 unsafe_policy) if replaying recent history shows it would auto-approve anything a human rejected or edited, unless force is set.

put.summary: Set the members of a reviewer group (owner only). Requests routed to a group can only be decided by its members or an owner.

post.summary: Ask for a human decision. The project's policy routes it (auto-approve, human, four-eyes or reject). Send Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key and body returns the original request (200); the same key with a different body is 409.

get.summary: List review requests (newest first), filterable by project, status, risk, group and externalId

post.summary: Dry run: how would this request be routed by the live policy (or a draft document)? Nothing is stored.

get.summary: Get a review request with its decisions

post.summary: Record a decision: approve, reject (veto), edit (replaces the payload; earlier approvals stop counting) or escalate. Routed requests need a member of the group (or an owner).
Cancel a pending request (requester only)

get.summary: Callback delivery log for a request

post.summary: Redeliver the request's callbacks now (including dead or already-succeeded ones). Receivers dedupe by callback id.

get.summary: Long-poll: returns as soon as the request is final, or after timeoutSeconds with its current state (check status; call again to keep waiting).
Server-sent events: `review` on every state change, then `end` (reason final | timeout). maxSeconds 1..55 (default 55); reconnect to continue.
Hash-chained audit trail for a request, with a full integrity check
Ed25519-signed decision receipt (final requests with a verified trail only); verifiable offline
Self-contained evidence pack: request, decisions, ledger, integrity, policy document, callbacks, receipt, public keys
Public keys for verifying decision receipts (current first, then retired)
Ledger entries after `since` as NDJSON (SIEM ingestion). Content-free: payloads appear only as hashes. Page with the last line's `at`.
